findings.evidence: `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Submatrix.lean:14-19` docstring: "Such permutations form a subgroup of `Equiv.Perm`, and this file records the three closure properties" ... "For the Cartan matrix of a Dynkin diagram these permutations are the diagram symmetries"; lemmas at lines 35, 40, 45 are stated for arbitrary `M : Matrix B B α`.
findings.fix: Add `def symmetryGroup (M : Matrix B B α) : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm B)` (carrier `{σ | M.submatrix σ σ = M}`) in `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Submatrix.lean`, proved from `submatrix_perm_refl/trans/symm`, and define `t.diagramSymmetry := symmetryGroup t.cartanMatrix`, keeping `mem_diagramSymmetry_iff` as the entrywise form (`mem_diagramSymmetry_iff_submatrix` then becomes `Iff.rfl`).
findings.issue: `diagramSymmetry` re-proves `one_mem'`/`mul_mem'`/`inv_mem'` entrywise for `t.cartanMatrix`, although the general form (permutations preserving an arbitrary square matrix) already exists; the natural statement is a subgroup of `Equiv.Perm B` for `M : Matrix B B α`, which also serves the `serreDiagramAut` consumer that takes exactly `CM.submatrix σ σ = CM`.

findings.evidence: Mathlib `RootPairing.Equiv.indexHom : Aut P →* (ι ≃ ι)` at `mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/Hom.lean:631`; `diagramAut_indexEquiv` is `rfl` (:308). `diagramAut_mul`'s proof only touches weight maps (`weightHom_injective`), so no circularity. grep for `diagramRootPerm_mul`/`diagramRootPerm_one` finds only their own statements.
findings.fix: Move them after `diagramAut_mul`/`diagramAut_one` and derive them, e.g. `simpa [diagramAut_indexEquiv] using congrArg (RootPairing.Equiv.indexHom _) (diagramAut_mul ht hσ hτ)` (and `map_one` for the identity case), or drop them.
findings.issue: `diagramRootPerm_mul` (:326) and `diagramRootPerm_one` (:337) are proved independently by root-injectivity, but they are the `indexEquiv` components of `diagramAut_mul` (:352) and `diagramAut_one` (:345), which are proved without them; both are unused elsewhere.

summary: The construction sits at the right level for the roadmap target, but two results are proved at a special case that the repo (or the PR itself) already has in general: the subgroup axioms of `diagramSymmetry` duplicate `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Submatrix.lean`, and `diagramRootPerm_mul`/`_one` re-prove consequences of `diagramAut_mul`/`_one`.
